slides.title: Confession: I moved all my chores to 2pm and my house changed
Notice your bright hours
slides.body: When it gets dark early, energy often dips with the light. Find your best window while the sun is up.

slides.title: Put the hard chore there
slides.body: Laundry folding, dishes, the counter. Ten minutes in daylight beats an hour of dread at night.

slides.title: Leave evenings for tiny things
slides.body: After dark, only 2-minute tasks. Shoes by the door, cup in the sink. That's it.

slides.title: Turn on every light
slides.body: Gloomy rooms feel bigger and messier. Lamps on before you start makes the job feel smaller.

slides.title: Use a weekend sun slot
slides.body: Pick one bright hour on Saturday for the job you've been avoiding. Put it in your calendar.

slides.title: You're not behind. You're working with less daylight.
